/* ============================================================
 *  HOW TO INTEGRATE INTO CubeMX-GENERATED Core/Src/main.c
 *  ============================================================
 *  Add code only inside the USER CODE regions.
 *  Do NOT modify anything outside USER CODE markers — those will
 *  be regenerated by CubeMX.
 * ============================================================ */

/* USER CODE BEGIN Includes */
#include "app.h"
/* USER CODE END Includes */


/* In int main(void), after every MX_*_Init() call: */

  /* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */
  App_Init();
  /* USER CODE END 2 */

  /* Infinite loop */
  /* USER CODE BEGIN WHILE */
  while (1)
  {
    App_Loop();
    /* USER CODE END WHILE */

    /* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */
  }
  /* USER CODE END 3 */


/* ============================================================
 *  Also make sure the following files generated by CubeMX exist
 *  (and are included by the .c files in app/):
 *      Core/Inc/main.h     (must define LCD_CS_Pin/Port,
 *                           LCD_DC_Pin/Port, LCD_RES_Pin/Port —
 *                           CubeMX creates these from the
 *                           "User Label" you set in Pinout view)
 *      Core/Inc/spi.h      (declares hspi1)
 *      Core/Inc/i2c.h      (declares hi2c1)
 *      Core/Inc/usart.h    (declares huart1)
 *      Core/Inc/rtc.h      (declares hrtc)
 * ============================================================ */
